title: qe_experiment_list summary mode returns full factor_names array (~156K tokens worst case)
description:
Expected: detail=summary returns factor_count: N instead of full factor_names array. Each item ~200 chars.
Actual: detail=summary returns full factor_names array with 57 names per experiment. Each item ~1700 chars. 367 experiments * 1700 = ~156K tokens worst case.
reproduce_command: curl -s http://localhost:8001/api/qe/experiments?detail=summary&limit=50 | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'items={len(d[\"items\"])}, factor_names_len={sum(len(i.get(\"factor_names\",[])) for i in d[\"items\"])}')"

events.note: Diagnosed 2026-05-27: factor_names is the dominant token cost in qe_experiment_list. Even limit=1 returns 57 factor names. Fix: detail=summary should return factor_count:int, detail=full keeps factor_names.
All 3 validation plans passed: L0, research_mcp_contract L2, qe_archive_backend L2. Summary mode now returns factor_count:int instead of factor_names:array. Empty metrics_summary omitted.
Merged to main (9f2853d2), pushed to GitHub. Post-merge L0 passed. Validation evidence: L0, qe_archive_backend L2, research_mcp_contract L2.
